### computerProcessStateSchema

```ts
const computerProcessStateSchema: ZodEnum<{
  running: "running";
  exited: "exited";
  uncertain: "uncertain";
}>;
```

`running`: computerd still reports the execution live. `exited`: it ended;
`exitCode` is null when the runtime that ran it was replaced or its record
expired before the exit code was observed. `uncertain`: the Computer could not
reach its container to check, so neither is claimed.

---

### computerProcessSyncSchema

```ts
const computerProcessSyncSchema: ZodEnum<{
  synced: "synced";
  pending: "pending";
  unknown: "unknown";
}>;
```

`synced`: the drain that recorded this exit read all the way to EOF, which is
also the read that runs computerd's post-command pull. `pending`: that drain
gave up waiting at its own deadline (a backgrounded child, for example
`node server.js &`, can hold the transport open long after its parent exits) --
a background continuation keeps watching and upgrades this row to `synced` once
it reaches that real EOF, so `pending` rows stay updatable. `unknown`: this exit
was recorded with no pull evidence at all (a replaced runtime, an expired
record, or any other exit path that never drained for one). Never claim `synced`
without the specific evidence for this exit; default to `unknown`, not `synced`.

### computerOperationStatusSchema

```ts
const computerOperationStatusSchema: ZodEnum<{
  accepted: "accepted";
  running: "running";
  succeeded: "succeeded";
  failed: "failed";
  unknown: "unknown";
  expired: "expired";
}>;
```

Where one command invocation stands: accepted, running, succeeded, failed,
unknown (the outcome cannot be established, because the Computer restarted
mid-command or the id has no record yet is still inside the admission window) or
expired (no record, and older than the admission window).

### computerCapabilities()

```ts
function computerCapabilities(): object[];
```

The operations every Computer advertises; static, so hosts can describe them
without a call. Built on first read: deriving JSON Schema for every operation is
real work that a Worker should not pay at startup.
